Workspace.title: Workspace
Workspace.description: Root school synchronization workspace owned by an authenticated user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the workspace owner.

schoolName.description: Display name of the school workspace.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the workspace was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the workspace was last updated.

AppStateEntry.title: AppStateEntry
AppStateEntry.description: Realtime synchronized application state entry stored using native Firestore maps/lists.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

storeKey.description: Application storage key prefixed with sd_.

payload.description: Native Firestore map wrapping the synchronized data under the 'data' key.

updatedBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user performing the update.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the entry was last updated.

email.description: Verified email address of the administrator.

assignedAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

/workspaces/{workspaceId}.description: Workspace root documents controlling access to synchronized school data.

/workspaces/{workspaceId}/appState/{stor.description: Realtime key-value documents synchronized across devices for the workspace.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Read-only admin registry used for RBAC verification.
